Class EnchantmentModifier

java.lang.Object
io.github.kaivian.klibrary.itemstack.modifier.EnchantmentModifier
All Implemented Interfaces:
ItemModifier
public class EnchantmentModifier extends Object implements ItemModifier
A modifier for adding, removing, or clearing enchantments on an item.

Supports both single and bulk enchantment operations, with optional level restriction bypass.

    • apply

      public void apply(@NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack itemStack, @NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.inventory.meta.ItemMeta meta)
      Description copied from interface: ItemModifier
      Applies this modification to the given item's metadata.

      The itemStack parameter is provided for type-specific checks (e.g., material validation), but all metadata changes should target the meta parameter. The meta is committed to the item automatically by the builder.

      Specified by:
      apply in interface ItemModifier
      Parameters:
      itemStack - the item stack being built (for read-only context)
      meta - the mutable metadata to modify
